explain_task.question: The objective rises from 150.0 in the original model to 160.0 in the revised model even though the revised optimal production still uses only off-peak method-1 batches. Trace that +10 change to the exact revised code additions: identify the new variable names and objective terms that cause it, and map each one back to the exact CSV field names and the business brief phrases about a "gate" and the furnace "cooldown burden." Then use the solver records to explain which constraints are binding versus slack in the revised LP relaxation and MIP solution—specifically `Min_Production`, `Offpeak_Activation_Link_1`, `Offpeak_Activation_Link_2`, and `Offpeak_Cooldown_i`—including the reported slack/dual values where available, the business meaning of those marginal values, and why you cannot linearly extrapolate the LP-relaxation shadow-price logic to predict the integer revised optimum when off-peak batches on one furnace cross the threshold 2.
